What I did

Forced browsing found unprotected hidden pages. Classic and UNION-based SQL injection gave an admin login and exposed user credentials.

Results

Broken access control (basket IDOR, forged feedback) and weak input validation (negative basket quantities) rounded out the findings.

Client-side validation is easy to bypass with an HTTP proxy.

Log signal: proxy/WAF log: SQLi payload on POST /rest/user/login, quantity -100 on PUT /api/BasketItems

Next

Add ownership checks on every API endpoint and validate number types and ranges on the server.

Withheld on purpose: credentials , flags and lab IPs .
